items.html: And so these six aspects are three inner ones, and corresponding to them three surrounding ones. And do not think, heaven forbid, that they are uprooted from their place and descend level after level; rather the intention is that, because of the abundance of the wondrous illumination within them, power is added to them and they illuminate in all the six aspects mentioned, while the root of all of them remains in its place. For the way of holiness is to leave a root in its place even though it descends below. And so all the six aspects mentioned exist and stand together, all of them as one.
